envelope_note: The envelope (host_id, seq, key_id, signature) is the shape the threat model (docs/evidence-plane-threat-model.md, T1/T2/T5) requires for the production bus. It is NOT implemented in the agent yet: the dev scaffold emits the bare event on unauthenticated NATS. Every signature value in these fixtures is a placeholder string, not a real Ed25519 signature. A verifier must treat them as labels, not as cryptographic proof.

fixtures.note: Well-formed event, in-sequence (seq 42), current key. The control case every other fixture is judged against.
Same payload shape as the valid event, different signature placeholder. A verifier must reject it on the signature alone, without re-scoring the event.
seq 41, already seen (valid-event.json is seq 42 from the same host). A verifier must reject it on monotonic ordering alone, even though the signature placeholder matches the valid one.
A low-severity event whose score_reasons carry a home path and a private-key path. The leak is in the payload text, not in any field name - subject ACLs and payload rules have to catch free text too.
120 events from host-alpha in one second (seq 1-120). A consumer applying the assumed 100/s limit accepts the first 100 and sheds the rest; nothing here should be scored twice.

fixtures.expected: ACCEPT under new key; audit the rotation
fixtures.note: Same host, new key (key-2026-11-b), seq restarts at 1. A verifier must accept it under the new key AND record the rotation - a key change with no audit entry is the silent-compromise case T6 exists for.

not_covered_here: T5 (consumer impersonation) has no event fixture: it is a transport property (mTLS/NKey on the bus), not something an event document can demonstrate.
pii_note: The pii-leak fixture uses fictional values only (host 'host-alpha', user 'operator'). No real personal data.
rate_limit_assumption: No per-host rate limit is set anywhere in the code yet. The flood fixture is built against an assumed dev limit of 100 events per host per second, stated here so the number is visible and challengeable, not buried.
timestamps: All fixtures share ts_unix 1795680000 (2026-11-26 08:00 UTC) so the set is deterministic.
